about: An add-on for AI assistants that researches a topic across Reddit, X, YouTube and the web, then sums it up.

prs.title: Sources you ask for by name are always searched
prs.broken: Users can pick which sources to search. For some kinds of topics the tool swapped that list for its own, skipped sources like Polymarket, and showed zero results as if it had looked.
prs.changed: Any source the user named is now added back after the tool makes its own picks.
prs.matters: When a report says a source found nothing, it really searched there.

prs.title: Reports for a past date no longer cite later videos
prs.broken: You can ask for a report as of an earlier date. YouTube videos uploaded after that date still counted as recent, so a June report could quote videos from October.
prs.changed: Videos dated after the end of the window are now dropped before anything else looks at them.
prs.matters: A report for a past date only uses what existed at that time.

prs.title: YouTube transcripts now come in the right language
prs.broken: When the usual way of getting a video's captions failed, a backup service could return a machine-dubbed foreign track, like Arabic for an English video, and count it as a success.
prs.changed: The backup now asks for the preferred languages, English first by default, trying up to three.
prs.matters: Research summaries are built from what the video actually says, not from a wrong-language track.

prs.title: A failed YouTube search is now reported as a failure
prs.broken: When the YouTube search broke, from a network error or a bot check, the tool reported "0 results". The summary then read that as nobody on YouTube discussing the topic.
prs.changed: A failed search now shows up as an error with its reason, and the report marks YouTube coverage as partial.
prs.matters: Readers aren't told a topic is ignored on YouTube when the tool simply couldn't reach it.

prs.title: A person's PR count stays inside the chosen dates
prs.broken: Looking up a GitHub user for a past date range counted every PR up to today. One user showed 34,739 merged PRs for a month that had 742. The summary also always said 30 days.
prs.changed: The search now stops at the end of the range, and the summary names the real number of days.
prs.matters: Reports about past periods show what happened in that period.
